newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Cobepa buys back, to cancel 640,137 shares.
newsitem.headline: Cobepa buys back, to cancel 640,137 shares.

text.p: Belgian holding company Compagnie Benelux Paribas SA (Cobepa) said on Tuesday it had bought back 640,137 of its own shares and would propose they be cancelled at a special shareholders meeting.

"The rights of the dividends from own shares held by Cobepa as at December 31, 1996 (640,137 shares) have been suspended and the profit appropriation will be made in respect of the 45,064,224 shares with dividend rights," Cobepa said in a statement accompanying its 1996 results.
Cobepa's 1996 current earnings rose nine percent to 2.95 billion Belgian francs.

Cobepa said it would propose to its annual general meeting on April 25 a net dividend of 43 francs a share, up from 40 francs in 1995. The extraordinary shareholders meeting to cancel the 640,137 shares would be held at the same time.
Cobepa is controlled by France's Compagnie Financiere Paribas.
